hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: We need to select ordered pairs of elements from both arrays to maximize product sum.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Formulate a state recording how many elements from each array and how many pairs have been formed so far.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Optimize transitions by maintaining the best previous score when extending to the next pair.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
